source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Compose UI goes through MemosViewModel and MemoService down to the SyncingRepository. This repository first writes to the local Room database and then syncs with the Memos server via MemosV1Api, hence offline operation.
